transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... well, people keep telling me they can't follow what I'm trying to explain. Like at work. My... my artist statements, or notes for clients. Even just talking in meetings. I guess I've been jumping around a lot. From, like, the textures... to the budgets... and then to, um, secret meanings in things. 

They just... they say they don't get it. So, I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or full of energy lately?

I guess so. Um... there are stretches where I just feel really lit up. Like I'm almost unstoppable, and every idea I have is just... brilliant. 

But... I don't know. It's also... if someone I'm working with makes even a small comment, I can just snap at them. In a way that feels a lot bigger than the situation, I guess. So, yeah.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can't hear?

Um... sometimes. I don't really like talking about it, but... yeah. 

When I'm alone in the studio, working late... I'll hear a woman's voice. Just... quietly commenting on things, coming from behind the supply shelves. Or I'll smell this really sharp scent of hot metal near a piece I'm working on. It feels completely real. But... when I go to look, or check the equipment, there's nothing there.
Have there been times when you heard the voice even though your mood was not especially high or energized?

Um... yeah. There was a... a quieter month, a little while ago. I was sleeping normally again, and I didn't have that... unstoppable feeling. 

But... I still heard the comments from behind the shelves. And I was still seeing those hidden warnings in my ordinary studio materials. That went on for a few weeks, even when my mood was fine.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I have off days, I guess. But... not for weeks at a time or anything.
During those lit-up periods, do you need much less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess so. When I get like that... I can just sleep for maybe two or three hours after working late. And then... I'll just wake up feeling bright, you know? Like I'm ready to keep going. I'm not tired at all, not the way I normally would be.
Have there been times when that lit-up, unstoppable state lasted at least a week?
Um... yeah. I think so. It definitely goes on for a while. Usually a week, maybe more... I don't really keep track of the days when I'm like that.
At any point, did the voices or hidden warnings continue for at least two weeks when your mood was otherwise normal?

Um... yeah, I suppose. There was... a quieter month. I was sleeping normally again, and I didn't feel unstoppable or anything. But... I still kept hearing those comments. Like, from behind the shelves. And I was still seeing those hidden warnings in my studio materials. That went on for... a few weeks, I think.
Do you believe the hidden warnings in your studio materials are actually messages meant specifically for you?

Yeah... I guess so. It's just... I get convinced that certain stains, or the seams on things... or even phrases in gallery emails are meant specifically for me. Like they're instructions, or warnings about my work. And... even when someone tries to show me a more ordinary explanation for it, it's... it's just very hard to let go of.
Have you become much less interested in seeing people or doing things you usually care about?
Um... no. Not really. I still go to my studio and... do my work. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
